description: This file defines a PHP class named ValidationDecorator which provides methods to modify validation rules for API parameters, specifically to enforce 'required' and 'not required' constraints in parameter validation logic.

classes.name: ValidationDecorator
classes.description: A helper class that adds specific validation rules to ParamRule objects, allowing for easy configuration of 'required' and 'not required' parameter validation logic.

methods.name: requiredParamRule
methods.description: Configures a ParamRule to enforce that a parameter is required, with an option to exclude empty strings from being accepted as valid values.

methods.name: notRequiredParamRule
methods.description: Configures a ParamRule to enforce that a parameter is not required, with an option to consider empty strings as acceptable or null during validation.
